agents.desc: Sets the spec and the invariants the system must never break.
Blue team. Implements each unit with its own tests.
Red team. Attacks the build — races, floods, malformed input, crashes.
Rebuilds offline from scratch and accepts or rejects each stage.

stages.name: Core money
stages.detail: No double-spend · no negative balance · conservation

stages.name: Safe retries
stages.detail: Idempotency keys — a retry can never charge twice

stages.name: Concurrency under attack
stages.detail: 500 concurrent workers · 0 lost payments · never wedges

stages.name: History + reversal
stages.detail: Paginated history + reversal at most once, never overdrawing

bugs.title: Silent lost payment
bugs.text: A split-network transfer could make a successful payment disappear from the client's view. Found, fixed, re-verified.

bugs.title: Memory denial-of-service
bugs.text: A flood of oversized requests blew server memory past 1 GB. Found, fixed, re-verified under attack.
